## 1. Prerequisite

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Required State"}

Before running this page, confirm that the project already exists and that the
operator is working from its root.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("README.md").exists(), "Expected README.md to exist before staging data."
assert Path("data").is_dir(), "Expected the data directory to exist before staging data."
```

:::

## 2. Procedure

::: {.manual-procedure title="Declare The Target Dataset"}

Record the dataset identifier and the intended staging location.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create The Staging Link"}

Create the staged location with `stagecoach` once the institutional command and
dataset identifier are available. The placeholder creates the expected path so
the page remains a bounded example.

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name

stage_path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
```

:::

## 3. Check

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Stage Result"}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

dataset_name = "example_registered_dataset"
stage_path = Path("data") / dataset_name

assert stage_path.exists(), "Expected staged dataset path to exist."
assert stage_path.is_dir(), "Expected staged dataset path to be a directory."
```
